nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite-dimensional real inner product space, viewed as a Riemannian manifold with the metric given by its inner product. For every $c \in F$, the constant vector field $y \mapsto c$ on $F$ is Killing.
nodes.title: Translations are Killing

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite-dimensional real inner product space, viewed as a Riemannian manifold with the metric given by its inner product, and let $A \colon F \to F$ be a continuous linear map. The linear vector field $y \mapsto A y$ is Killing if and only if $A$ is skew-adjoint: $\langle A u, w \rangle + \langle u, A w \rangle = 0$ for all $u, w \in F$.
nodes.title: Linear Killing fields on Euclidean space

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite-dimensional real inner product space, viewed as a Riemannian manifold with the metric given by its inner product. A vector field $V$ on $F$ is Killing if and only if $V$ is $C^\infty$ and its derivative is skew-adjoint at every point: for all $x, u, w \in F$, $\langle DV(x)\,u, w \rangle + \langle u, DV(x)\,w \rangle = 0$.
nodes.title: Killing fields on Euclidean space
